title: Glory of Christ
definition: The glory of Christ is the divine beauty, majesty, excellence, and worth revealed in His person, work, humiliation, exaltation, and reign.
summary: Jesus is glorious in His deity, grace, truth, cross, resurrection, and kingdom.
christFocus: Christ reveals the glory of God and draws His people into worship and transformation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The glory of Christ is seen in His divine identity, His humble incarnation, His perfect obedience, His compassion, His cross, His resurrection, and His exalted reign.

The world often misses Christ's glory because it looks for worldly power. Scripture reveals glory in the crucified and risen Son.

Beholding Christ's glory transforms believers by the Spirit and fuels worship, holiness, and mission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers can become spiritually dull when they lose sight of Christ's glory. This doctrine matters because the soul needs to behold Him as supremely worthy.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Look often to the glory of Christ in Scripture. Let His beauty and worth reshape your desires, priorities, and worship.
